scripts.text:
^4d4dffOnce you leave this island there is no way back.
Are you sure you want to go directly to Izlude?^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff一旦离开这座岛，就没有回来的路了。
您确定要直接前往依斯鲁得岛吗？^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffIf you do, the quest will be deleted from your Quest Log.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff如果这样做，任务将从您的任务日志中删除。^000000

scripts.text: Do not go to Izlude yet

[Sailor]
You want to stay here longer?
Good, then I'll wait until you're ready~
scripts.translation:
[水手]
您想在这里多待一会儿吗？
好的，那我就等您准备好了再出发~

[水手]
让我们出发前往依斯鲁得岛吧！
